evidence_contract: Exact number, sign, unit, date and currency multiplicity from source-native text. This does not establish reading order or semantic completeness.
routing: Run Native and MinerU first. Run olmOCR2 only when MinerU has at least one source-critical-token mismatch.
strict_disposition: UNRESOLVED when neither model has zero mismatches.
baseline_retaining_disposition: Retain MinerU with REVIEW_REQUIRED when neither model has zero mismatches.
override: Accept olmOCR2 only when MinerU has one or more mismatches and olmOCR2 has zero mismatches.
